parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello?

Oh, hello. I'm calling about a vacation rental. The name I've been given is Carol Marriott.

I'm Dave, Carol's husband. We own it together.

Oh, right. Well, some friends of ours rented Astor Cottage from you for a week by the ocean last summer, and they recommended it to us.

My husband and I would like to rent it in the fall for a week.

Okay. Why not?

Exactly. We're looking at the week beginning September 21st, if it's available.

Let me check. No, I'm sorry, it's already booked that week. You could have it the previous week from the 14th.

Well, we could manage that week if we change a couple of arrangements. How much would it cost?

That would be $835.

Ah, that's rather more than we wanted to pay, I'm afraid. We were hoping to pay closer to $790, which our friends paid last year.

We also have a slightly smaller cottage called Periwinkle Cottage.

Excuse me. How do you spell the name?

P-E-R-I-W-I-N-K-L-E. Periwinkle. It's available the week you want it, and it's the exact same price that your friends paid last year. I take it you want a place that sleeps just two people like Astor Cottage?

Yes. Is it near Astor Cottage?

Yeah. It's right across the street.

And what's this cottage like?

Well, it's a part of a historic building that was originally a school 100 years ago. It was converted into a post office around 1950.

Then later on, the post office moved and the building was divided to make two cottages.

So, is it on several floors?

No, it's all on one floor. There's a large living room, a kitchen that's really well-equipped, a bedroom, and a bathroom with a tub and a shower.

Oh, very nice.

From the living room, you can go out onto the deck, which is a great place to have your meals when the weather's nice.

That sounds fantastic. Can you see the river that flows through the town from the cottage?

You sure can. It's close by. You can see it from the bedroom.

Okay. Would we need to bring anything? Bedding, say?

That's provided. But we make a small charge for towels, unless you bring your own, of course.

Oh, okay. I'll do that. Because we'll be driving, there'll be plenty of room in the car for things like that. Oh, that reminds me. Is there a garage that we can use?

I'm afraid there isn't one, but you can usually get a parking spot on the street right in front of the cottage.

No problem. We probably won't use the car much while we're there anyway. We like to go for walks.

Oh, and what about the town itself? Are there any restaurants in the neighborhood?

There are a few, all within walking distance. A lot of people like the fish restaurant, but in my opinion, the Chinese restaurant has got to be the best for miles around.

That's good to know. We might end up eating out every evening.

Well, why not?

Our friends said the town is pretty famous for antique stores.

That's right. There's a whole bunch of them, at least 10 on the main street.

Marvelous. OK, I'd like to make the booking, please.

Great. We ask for a deposit of $200 and final payment at least six weeks before you stay. But we'll be away ourselves for much of August. So let's say no later than the last day of July. Is that OK with you?

Fine.

OK. Then let me give you our details so you can send the deposit.

analyses.content: 房东说原本想要的21号那周已经订出去了，建议选择前一周，即从 14th 开始。
Let me check. No, I'm sorry, it's already booked that week. You could have it the previous week from the 14th.
万别填 21st，录音明确说那天 "already booked"（已经被预订了）。
How much would it cost? That would be $835. Ah, that's rather more than we wanted to pay, I'm afraid. We were hoping to pay closer to $790, which our friends paid last year.
你可能听到 $790，但那是女士的朋友去年支付的价格，或者是她心理预期的价格，不是现在的实价。
女士询问更换日期后的价格，房东直接回答是 $835。
Well, it's a part of a historic building that was originally a school 100 years ago. It was converted into a post office around 1950.
不要填 post office，录音说那是后来（around 1950）才改建成的用途。
房东介绍说这栋建筑在100年前“最初（originally）”是一所 school（学校）。
From the living room, you can go out onto the deck, which is a great place to have your meals when the weather's nice.
这里没有太强的干扰项，注意听到 "go out onto" 后紧跟的名词即可。
录音提到从客厅可以直接走到 deck（露台/甲板）上，天气好的时候可以在那吃饭。
That sounds fantastic. Can you see the river that flows through the town from the cottage? You sure can. It's close by. You can see it from the bedroom.
题目问的是 view of the...（...的景色），所以要填看到的物体 river，而不是看的位置 bedroom。
女士问能不能看到河流，房东确认说可以，并且特别指出是从 bedroom 看到 river。
房东说除非客人自己带 towels（毛巾），否则会收取少量费用，女士随即表示她会自己带。
That's provided. But we make a small charge for towels, unless you bring your own, of course. Oh, okay. I'll do that.
不要填 Bedding（床上用品），录音明确说 Bedding 是 "provided"（提供的）。
Oh, that reminds me. Is there a garage that we can use? I'm afraid there isn't one, but you can usually get a parking spot on the street right in front of the cottage.
不要听到 parking spot 就填，录音说的是街上有停车位，但并没有车库。
女士问有没有车库，房东回答 "I'm afraid there isn't one"（恐怕没有）。
A lot of people like the fish restaurant, but in my opinion, the Chinese restaurant has got to be the best for miles around.
题目问的是 "owner recommends"（房东推荐），所以要忽略大家都喜欢的 fish restaurant。
房东说虽然很多人喜欢鱼餐厅，但他个人认为（in my opinion）Chinese（中餐）馆是方圆几里最好的。
Great. We ask for a deposit of $200 and final payment at least six weeks before you stay.
注意区分定金金额和后面提到的时间日期数字，只要听到 "deposit of..." 就可以锁定答案。
房东非常直接地提出要求，定金（deposit）是 $200。
But we'll be away ourselves for much of August. So let's say no later than the last day of July. Is that OK with you?
千万别听到 August 就填，那是房东 "away"（不在）的时间，不是付款截止时间。
房东说因为他们八月份不在，所以要求在 July（七月）的最后一天前付清余款。
